# Peace Surfers

A surf store specializing in handmade products crafted for surfers. The brand carries an artisanal, authentic ocean-lifestyle vibe, blending the raw energy of surf culture with the craftsmanship and uniqueness of handmade goods. Each product reflects a passion for the waves and the surf community.

Source: https://example.com

Handmade with Purpose

## Crafted for the Waves,Built to Last


Every piece in our surf store begins by hand — shaped, finished, and tested against salt air and open water. No shortcuts, no mass production. Just honest craft made for surfers who live in the ocean.









### Small-Batch Making


Each item is produced in limited runs so every detail gets the attention it deserves. Hand-finished textures and natural material variation mean no two pieces are exactly alike — your gear carries its own story before it ever hits the water.













### Surf-Ready Construction


Built to withstand sun, salt, and repeat use. We select materials that harden with exposure rather than degrade — waxed surfaces, reinforced stitching, and thoughtful forms that hold their integrity session after session, season after season.













### One-of-a-Kind Character


Natural materials breathe, fade, and develop patina over time. The grain in the wood, the pull in the weave, the tone of the pigment — these are features, not flaws. Like a wavelength surf shop built on soul, our pieces grow more personal the more you use them.































The World We Ride

## Salt Air & Handmade Soul


Ocean mornings that smell like wax and cedar. Workshop corners where every stitch and knot is set by hand. At Peace Surfers, we craft objects meant to age with the sea — worn beautifully, used hard, and passed on. This is the surf store where craft meets the current.











Dawn patrol — board shaped by hand












Workshop — where every piece begins






Made to last a thousand tides









Every morning is a new set — wavelength surf shop living

























From the Community

## Where Every Wave Starts by Hand — Peace Surfers

URL: https://example.com/craftsmanship
Description: Explore the art behind every product at Peace Surfers. Our wavelength surf shop-inspired craftsmanship blends raw surf culture with handmade precision. Feel the difference quality makes.

Where Every Wave Starts by Hand — Peace Surfers

All Products
















The Peace Surfers Way


# Made by Hand,Shaped by the Sea


Every piece we craft at Peace Surfers begins not on a production line, but with a feeling — the weight of a wave, the pull of a current, the quiet after a clean ride. Our goods are shaped by function and finished by hand, drawing on years of ocean experience and a deep respect for the materials we work with. This is not mass production. This is intentional making, one piece at a time, for surfers who know the difference.




### Craft That Earns Its Place in the Lineup


From our surf store workshop to the water's edge — each product is tested, refined, and built to last beyond a single season.







Workshop, Peace Surfers Studio


















THE CRAFT

## From Raw Materialto Ready Ride


Every Peace Surfers product passes through four deliberate stages — no shortcuts, no compromises. Just honest handmade work built to last in the water.









01




Sourcing

### Materials That Earn Their Place


We start at the source — selecting only natural fibres, sustainably harvested woods, and ocean-safe waxes from suppliers who share our values. At our surf store, every raw ingredient is handled and assessed by hand before it ever meets a shaping tool. If it doesn't feel right, it doesn't make the cut.












02








Shaping

### Formed by Hand, Not Machine


Shaping is where intention becomes form. Our craftspeople work slowly and deliberately, reading the grain, feeling the resistance, and adjusting with each pass. No two pieces are identical — that variance is the signature of genuine handcraft. The result is a product with a character you can hold in your hands.








03




Finishing

### Sealed for Salt, Sun & Time


Finishing is the stage most people never see — and the one that determines how long a product endures. We sand, seal, and treat each piece with natural protective coatings that resist saltwater, UV exposure, and the general violence of life in the surf. Every edge is checked. Every surface is earned.








Salt-Resistant Seal

Natural beeswax and plant-oil coating on all exposed surfaces








UV Protection

Treated to withstand prolonged sun and glare at the break








Edge Integrity

Hand-checked seams and corners for lasting durability










04



Field Testing

### Proven in the Water


Before anything reaches our innerlight surf shop floor, it goes in the ocean. Real surfers, real conditions — cold mornings, overhead sets, rocky entries. We believe a product earns its place through performance, not promises. Only what survives the water makes it to you.


“

If it can't handle a wipeout, it doesn't leave the workshop.


























Raw Materials

## Crafted Fromthe Earth &the Ocean


Every Peace Surfers piece begins with an honest material — natural fibers that breathe, weathered woods that age beautifully, waxed cloth that repels salt and sun. We source for longevity, tactility, and respect for the craft. This is what separates a handmade surf store from the rest.



Selected for surf life. Built to age with grace.













### Natural Fibers


We work with organic cotton, hemp, and linen — raw, unbleached, and sourced from small-batch suppliers who share our values. These fibers wear in rather than wear out, developing character with every session and every wash. The wavelength surf shop community deserves materials that feel as good as the ocean itself.











### Weathered Wood & Waxed Cloth


Reclaimed timber and cold-processed waxed canvas form the structural backbone of our boards, bags, and accessories. The wood carries the memory of the sea. The waxed cloth hardens against spray and softens against skin — a paradox only found in materials that have earned their place in the surf store lineage.












### Durable Fastenings & Tactile Finishes


Solid brass rivets, hand-stitched waxed thread, and cold-forged buckles hold everything together — literally and philosophically. We finish surfaces by hand: sanded smooth, oiled or waxed, never painted over. At our hobies surf shop-inspired atelier, the finish is the story. Run your fingers across it and you'll know it was made by someone who surfs.





















What We Stand For

## Built on Conviction,Shaped by the Sea


At Peace Surfers, every handmade product carries a philosophy. These aren't just words — they're the principles that guide every wax, every stitch, and every board we craft. Like any good surf store worth its salt, we believe what you stand on reflects who you are.









01


### Authenticity Over Mass Production


We make things by hand because machines can't feel the ocean. Each product that leaves our workshop is touched, shaped, and finished by someone who surfs — someone who understands what the water demands. No factory floors, no assembly lines, no compromise. Just honest craft made for real surfers.






02


### Longevity Over Throwaway Culture


We're tired of gear that dies after a season. Everything we create is built to outlast trends, endure salt and sun, and age with character rather than decay. When you invest in a Peace Surfers piece, you're choosing something that earns its patina — a companion for years of sessions, not just a few weekends.






03


### Community Over Trend Chasing


Surf culture was never meant to be a marketing category. It's a living, breathing community of people drawn together by the same pull of the tide. We build for that community — the dawn patrol regulars, the weekend warriors, the kids learning to pop up for the first time. Not for the algorithm. Not for the season drop.




















Let's Talk Craft

## Find Your Perfect Handmade Piece


Whether you're looking for a one-of-a-kind board bag, a hand-stitched leash, or want to collaborate on something entirely new — we're here for the conversation. At Peace Surfers, every piece starts with a story. Tell us yours and let's shape something worth riding with.

## Born From Salt, Built With Soul — Peace Surfers

URL: https://example.com/about
Description: Peace Surfers isn&#39;t just a surf store — it&#39;s a movement. Learn how our passion for the waves and the surf community shaped an innerlight surf shop spirit into every handmade piece we create.

Born From Salt, Built With Soul — Peace Surfers

Our Story

# Born from the Ocean,Built by Hand


Peace Surfers began with a single conviction: that the gear you carry into the water should carry meaning. We started as surfers ourselves — people who understood the particular joy of a well-shaped board, a wax bar made with care, a leash that felt like it was made for your wrist alone. What we found in most surf stores was the opposite: rows of identical product, manufactured far from any coastline, designed by committees who had never felt a dawn swell. So we built something different. Peace Surfers is a hobies surf shop rooted in handmade culture — a place where every item on the shelf began as someone's idea of the perfect thing, shaped slowly and with intention.


We believe the best surf store isn't the biggest one. It's the one that knows its craft, respects its community, and stocks products that tell a story. Each piece we carry reflects that wavelength — handmade, honest, and tied to the ocean in a way mass production never could be.




100%
Handmade Products



Est.
By Surfers, For Surfers









Every board has a story. Every wave, a reason.
















Our Story


## Shaped by the Sea,Made by Hand


Every board wax, every stitched leash, every shaped fin — each one traces back to a moment of honest craft. This is how Peace Surfers came to be.





All Products
















Chapter 01




### First Experiments in the Garage


It started with leftover wax, salvaged neoprene scraps, and a kitchen table. Long before Peace Surfers became a surf store, it was a personal obsession — shaping small handmade accessories that actually worked in the water. The first prototypes were rough, honest, and full of salt.









Chapter 02







### The Local Surf Community Took Notice


Word spread through the lineup. Local surfers at our home break started asking where to get the gear. That early local support — trading pieces at the carpark, gifting fins to friends — gave Peace Surfers its first real identity as something the surf community genuinely wanted.









Chapter 03




### Refining Every Material


Cheap materials don't survive the ocean. We spent seasons testing — natural waxes, sustainably sourced cords, hand-dyed fabrics that hold colour through salt and sun. Refinement wasn't a phase, it became a philosophy: every material earns its place in the product or it doesn't come with us.









Chapter 04







### A Distinct Artisanal Surf Identity


What began as garage experiments grew into a real surf store with a clear soul. Peace Surfers today is a wavelength surf shop built on handmade integrity — each product still shaped, stitched, or crafted by hand. Not mass-produced. Not generic. Just honest goods made for people who live for the waves.



























Our Beliefs

## The Way We Make.The Way We Live.








01


### Made with Integrity


Every product that leaves our hands carries the weight of a choice — to do it right. At Peace Surfers, we work with materials sourced honestly, shaped by hand, and finished with patience. There are no shortcuts in a good board bag or a wax that holds. We believe the surf store should stand behind what it sells, the way the ocean stands behind every wave — completely, without compromise.







02


### Stay Close to the Sea


The ocean is not a backdrop — it is our workshop, our compass, and our quality test. We paddle out before we open the doors. We watch the swell before we shape the next piece. Staying close to the sea means our work is always honest: the products we make are tested in real water, by real surfers, in real conditions. Wavelength and tide are part of every design decision we make.


Nothing we create is meant to sit on a shelf and look good. It is meant to get wet, get used, and earn its place in your quiver.











03


### Objects of Ritual, Not Disposal


The surf ritual begins before you hit the water. The way you wax your board, the bag you roll your wetsuit into, the cord you thread through your fin — these are acts of care. We make things that deserve that care in return. Our products are not disposable commodities. They are companions in a practice that asks everything of you. Treat them well, and they will carry you further than you expect.



















Our Community

## Built on Salt, Sun & Shared Mornings


Peace Surfers was never just a surf store — it grew out of a circle of wave-riders who believed that handmade goods, honest craft, and early-morning sessions belong together. We are part of a real ocean-going community, and every product we make carries that spirit forward.











### Local Surf Culture, First


We show up before sunrise. We know the breaks, the tides, and the faces. Our roots run deep in the local surf scene — from the hobies surf shop era to today — and that intimacy shapes every board bag, wax comb, and handstitched leash we craft.








### Maker Relationships


Every item in our wavelength surf shop is made by hand — by people we know by name. We collaborate with local artisans, shaping partners, and textile makers who share our obsession with quality and the ocean. No mass production, no shortcuts, just genuine craft.








### The Ocean Is Our Gathering Place


Whether it's a flat-day paddle, a dawn patrol session, or a post-surf coffee on the sand, Peace Surfers is wherever the community gathers. We belong to the innerlight surf shop spirit — the idea that the best things happen when surfers come together around something real.









Dawn patrol — our people, our ocean.







“The best surf store is the one that feels like it belongs to everyone who paddles out.”

— The Peace Surfers Crew









Handcrafted boards & coastal gear rooted in the rhythm of the ocean. Made with care, ridden with soul.

Got Questions?

## Frequently Asked














### Why does my handmade product look slightly different from the photos?


Every piece at Peace Surfers is crafted by hand — shaped, stitched, or finished one at a time by skilled artisans who love the ocean as much as you do. Natural materials, hand-applied finishes, and the organic process of making mean no two items are ever identical. These subtle variations in grain, texture, or tone are not flaws — they're proof of genuine craft. Your piece is truly one of a kind, the same way no two waves are ever the same.











### How quickly will you respond to my message or custom order inquiry?


We're a small, passionate crew — not a faceless surf store chain. We read every message personally and aim to reply within 1–2 business days. For custom requests, partnership ideas, or wholesale inquiries, allow a little extra time so we can give your question the thoughtful answer it deserves. Drop us a line through the contact form or reach us directly by email, and we'll get back to you as soon as the tide allows.











### Can you help me find the right product or explore a collaboration?


Absolutely — that's what we're here for. Whether you're hunting for the perfect board bag, a handmade wax comb, or a gift for a fellow surfer, we're happy to guide you toward the right piece. We also love connecting with shapers, artists, photographers, and surf communities who share our values. Tell us what you have in mind and let's see if we can make something happen together. Real surfers, real conversations — no bots, no scripts.

















Find Us In The Wild

## Come As You Are,Leave With Something Real


We run on tide schedules and good vibes. Peace Surfers isn't just a surf store — it's a place where handmade craft meets coastal rhythm. Whether you're stopping by to pick up a board bag stitched by hand or just want to talk waves, the door is always open.


Like any good surf shop, we move at the pace of the ocean. If you reach out and we're catching a set, we'll get back to you before sundown. We believe the best conversations happen in person — so swing by, touch the goods, and feel the difference that handmade makes.







Best Time to Visit
Mornings before 11am or late afternoons — the shop breathes easier then







Response Time
We reply within a tide cycle — usually same day, never rushed







Studio Atmosphere
Wax in the air, boards on the wall, salt on everything — it's the real thing

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 6/2/2026



At Peace Surfers, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  4/14/2026



Peace Surfers ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Peace Surfers

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  April 14, 2026



Peace Surfers is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Peace Surfers

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

- "Company" - Peace Surfers

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - retail / surf & outdoor provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


Peace Surfers provides retail / surf & outdoor through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations

## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.
